Objectives
- What is the overall objective of this project? What are problem are we trying to solve? How is this project going to help or improve the car/specific system?

Description
- Briefly describe what needs to be designed, developed, investigated, or integrated. Include relevant technical areas, skills, or knowledge that may be required.

Scope
- What is included in this project? What is explicitly outside its scope? 

Considerations
- Relevant assumptions, constraints, dependencies, uncertainties, or other factors to keep in mind.

Challenges
- What technical or practical challenges are expected?

Mechanical Consult
- The car is mostly mechanical and integrating this solution might require consulting with members from other subsystem. Could put their contact info here
